notes: Translated from OVAL's validation file odrl12_invalid (JSON-LD), which OVAL's SHACL validator must reject. Changed: written in Turtle; rule named; Rule and Constraint types added; conflict declared; OVAL's example profile IRI dropped. Its left operand runningTime is no term of the ODRL vocabulary (the W3C JSON-LD context does not define it, so it expands against the document base) and no profile binds it, so the constraint runningTime lt 60 (xsd:integer, unit qudt MinuteTime) is replaced by an odrl:dateTime bound with no unit, which due2-core binds; the constraint's place, which is what the case tests, is unchanged. Written as odrl:refinement, the collection would still be rejected, as UnsupportedConstruct: due2 admits no collection refinement (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3). OVAL keeps no result beyond the rejection.

expected_rejection.why: The AssetCollection that <http://example.com/policy:4444#play> targets carries an odrl:constraint, and the ODRL vocabulary places a constraint only on a Policy or a Rule (Vocabulary §3.14.2); a collection is narrowed by odrl:refinement (IM §2.5.5). Normalisation rejects a constraint outside its place in stage 1 (odrl-compound-to-atomic-normalization.md §3), so W1 rejects the policy.

oval_expected.result: invalid: OVAL's SHACL validator must reject it
